actions.action: Require receipt confirmation before changing the holder
actions.mechanism: A proposed handoff stays unresolved until the receiving volunteer confirms possession; intent does not establish custody.
actions.implementation: Provide Offer and Confirm receipt buttons in one shared record. Display last confirmed holder, intended recipient, and pending status.
actions.check: Offer a transfer without confirming it. Verify the holder remains unchanged and the unresolved handoff is visible.
actions.risk: Forgotten confirmation leaves physical possession uncertain.

actions.action: Keep a timestamped, append-only handoff history
actions.mechanism: Preserved events make custody changes reconstructable without searching conversational messages or trusting an overwritten status.
actions.implementation: Record sender, recipient, physical handoff time, and submission time. Require handoff time on confirmation; append corrections rather than deleting entries.
actions.check: Enter a delayed confirmation, then correct its time. Verify both versions remain and the latest valid custody state is displayed.
actions.risk: Volunteer-entered physical times may be approximate.

actions.mechanism: Version checks and unique transfer identifiers prevent stale screens or repeated taps from producing contradictory custody records.
actions.implementation: Allow one pending transfer. Atomically validate the current holder and record version; process each confirmation identifier only once.
actions.check: Submit competing offers from stale screens, then repeat a confirmation. Verify one transfer survives and custody changes only once.
actions.risk: Rejected submissions need clear refresh instructions.

actions.action: Add an explicit custody-dispute recovery path
actions.mechanism: An uncertainty state exposes conflicting reports instead of presenting the last recorded holder as verified physical possession.
actions.implementation: Let either volunteer flag uncertainty. Preserve the last confirmed holder; require a named possession claim and the other's acknowledgment to resolve it.
actions.check: Flag conflicting possession reports. Verify uncertainty stays visible until both volunteers acknowledge the same resolution, with its time recorded.
actions.risk: Resolution stalls when either volunteer cannot respond.

actions.mechanism: Age-based prompts draw attention to incomplete transfers without silently declaring that custody changed.
actions.implementation: Choose a reminder interval together. Notify the recipient of pending receipt confirmation and keep the unresolved item pinned for both volunteers.
actions.check: Leave a test handoff pending beyond the interval. Verify a reminder appears, custody stays unchanged, and confirmation stops further prompts.
actions.risk: Frequent reminders can become background noise.

actions.action: Separate future arrangements from actual possession
actions.mechanism: Plans and reservations cannot overwrite custody, preventing statements such as 'I'll take it tomorrow' from becoming false location information.
actions.implementation: Add a separate Planned handoff section with intended participants and scheduled time. Require the ordinary receipt-confirmation process for actual transfer.
actions.check: Schedule tomorrow's transfer and let its scheduled time pass. Verify current custody remains unchanged and no completed handoff is fabricated.
actions.risk: Volunteers may mistake scheduling for completing the transfer.

actions.action: Offer a paper ledger as a digital alternative
actions.mechanism: A fixed, shared ledger provides inspectable custody records without hardware, accounts, or reliance on chat access.
actions.implementation: Instead of the digital workflow, keep a ledger somewhere both can access without the key. Record each handoff's time, names, and both initials.
actions.check: Leave a transfer row missing recipient initials. Verify either volunteer can identify the last jointly confirmed holder and unresolved transfer.
actions.risk: Requires visiting the ledger; missing entries remain possible.
